item.title: Incarico post-doc: The Federico II Prison University Centre at Secondigliano Prison. Scope of work: a study of the spaces and of possible extensions and refurbishments, with a view to drawing up new national guidelines. (Univ. NAPOLI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. NAPOLI, Napoli
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The Federico II University Penitentiary Center at the Secondigliano P. Mandato Penitentiary Center was founded in 2017 and opened in the first academic year (2018-2019). The over 100 students are divided into two sections: the high-security "Ionio" and the medium-security "Mediterraneo." The spaces, and therefore the time and movement options within the Pavilions, are very different, and the University, as part of the work of the National Conference of Penitentiary Facilities (PUP) at the CRUI (Italian University Rectorate), is committed to developing guidelines for national penitentiary facilities with PUPs. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Advanced methods for masonry structural analysis and metamaterial design (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-06 Scienza delle costruzioni

The project is structured into two research lines. The first concerns the analysis of masonry structures and aims to develop models and algorithms for safety assessment, with particular attention to thrusting systems such as arches, vaults and arch bridges, using methods based on limit analysis. The load-bearing capacity of the structures, the effects of support settlements and collapse mechanisms will be examined. The second line focuses on the study of metamaterials through the design of units and lattices with programmable nonlinear responses, aimed at developing bistable, multistable or high-performance structures. In particular, metamaterials inspired by tensegrity and origami…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: 2026-IpdDip-03-DICAR- Advanced numerical modelling in geotechnical engineering for the assessment and mitigation of risks posed by natural hazards to structures and infrastructure (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-05 Geotecnica

The research programme is aimed at the development and application of advanced numerical modelling methodologies in geotechnical engineering for assessing the safety and resilience of structures and infrastructure exposed to natural hazards, with particular reference to seismic and hydrogeological hazards. The activity will include the definition and calibration of numerical and digital models, the simulation of the effects induced by natural events, and the analysis of risk mitigation strategies. The effectiveness of mitigation measures and the interactions between soil, structures and infrastructure will also be assessed through selected case studies. The activities are part of Action 2…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Graphic representation strategies for the simultaneous and comparative analysis of architectural drawings in the S/D/R Archive of the Department of History, Drawing and Restoration of Architecture, Sapienza University of Rome (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-10 Disegno

This research aligns with contemporary strategies for engaging with the Sapienza archives dedicated to architectural drawing education; it involves systematizing knowledge of Rome’s built heritage, selecting diverse datasets, and managing and standardizing the processes of data acquisition and archiving. The project aims to develop methods and tools for the multidimensional exploration, interpretation, and analysis of archival data. This will foster interactive, dynamic engagement with the drawings and encourage new lines of inquiry tailored to diverse audiences, thereby enhancing the tangible and intangible assets of the Roman School’s tradition. item.description:

Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-02 Ingegneria sanitaria-ambientale, ingegneria e sicurezza degli scavi, delle materie prime, degli idrocarburi e fluidi nel sottosuolo

The research activity, within the scientific field CEAR-02/C – Raw Materials Engineering, will focus on the development of methodologies for the characterization, classification and sorting of primary and secondary raw materials, waste and process residues, as well as for the monitoring of environmental matrices and contaminants. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Environmental impacts and mitigation measures for pumped storage hydropower in Norwegian reservoirs (EnviPump) – Project number: 358659 - CUP E63C25002370005 (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-27 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-01 Idraulica, idrologia, costruzioni idrauliche e marittime

The project aims to understand the effect of pumping operations in coupled reservoirs used for hydroelectric power generation, in which part of the water that is normally turbined as it flows from the upstream reservoir to the downstream reservoir is pumped back upstream when the price of electricity is sufficiently low. Particular attention will be paid to the impacts of such operations on the thermal stratification of the reservoirs and on the formation and stability of the ice layer at the surface, which will also be assessed on the basis of the interpretation of satellite imagery (SAR and visible). item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The research is primarily aimed at developing and applying methods and guidelines to assess the impacts and benefits of ITS and C-ITS systems on transportation networks. The study will evaluate user experience, benefits in terms of traffic flow and safety (including vulnerable road users, cyclists, and public transportation systems), and environmental effects (emissions and sustainability); where relevant, the impact on autonomous vehicles will be assessed.
